subject: Heart Container in Chapter 6
text: After leaving the ship, walk to the mountain without entering the city, then go straight until you enter inside the mountain.

evidence.quote: depois de descer da nave caminhe para a montanha no entre na cidade, siga reto at entrar dentro da montanha
evidence.translation: After getting off the ship, walk to the mountain, do not enter the city, go straight until you enter inside the mountain
